document_control.package_name: ABox Lucie M00 Platform Foundation Build Packet
document_control.lucie_posture: Lean, fixed-behavior, AI-buildable MVP; not a configurable Phase 1 or North Star implementation.
document_control.prepared_for: Athina, Michael, and the JET product, design, engineering, QA, security, privacy, operations and release teams
document_control.change_rule: Stable IDs are never renumbered or reused; behavior changes require controlled change and prior-module impact review.
document_control.certification_scope: Implementation-grade requirements, contracts, migrations, tests, runbooks and governed M01 deltas for production software delivery.
document_control.deployment_boundary: This packet is not deployed software. Production activation still requires implemented code, executed evidence, UAT, security/privacy/legal/provider approvals and JET release authorization.

Acceptance_Criteria.criterion: Given an authorized actor and all stated prerequisites, when provider account ownership and commercial sourcing is exercised, the observable result conforms to M00-DISC-INT-003 including its ownership, fixed states, scope, and evidence rules.
Acceptance_Criteria.requirement_title: Provider account ownership and commercial sourcing
Acceptance_Criteria.requirement_statement: For Twilio SMS, DocuSign electronic signature, and approved secure email/gateway, each agency chooses independently between AGENCY_OWNED and JET_PAY_TO_USE. Under agency-owned, the agency owns the provider agreement/license and capacity; JET securely configures and operates the ABox connection, never redisplays credentials, and may suspend invalid or noncompliant connections. Under JET pay-to-use, JET owns the provider account, attributes usage by tenant/service/transaction/date/marketplace/outcome, and handles charges through the commercial agreement without an automated billing engine. Each tenant has one active production route per service. Model changes are controlled, future-effective where necessary, tested, audited, protect in-flight transactions, and preserve historical provider association. If no route is active, dependent functionality remains unavailable and never silently uses JET paid capacity.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 01
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Canonical Tenant, Organization, OrganizationRelationship, and MarketplaceContext records are never created in M00.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 02
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Every protected action has server-resolved user or workload identity, tenant, organization, marketplace, role, policy version, and correlation context as applicable.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 03
Business_Rule_Register.statement: No normal workflow reads or writes another tenant's records; support access is explicit, time-limited, reason-coded, and audited.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 04
Business_Rule_Register.statement: One person has one global user_id; actor profiles and scoped business records do not create duplicate identities.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 05
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Role, membership, affiliation, sellability, account, tenant, marketplace, and recent-authentication restrictions all participate in access decisions.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 06
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Regulated selling fails closed when M08 sellability is missing, stale, unavailable, BLOCKED, or REVIEW_REQUIRED unless the downstream rule explicitly permits review-only work.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 07
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Commercial activation, entitlement, feature enablement, launch gate, provider route, and tenant/marketplace status must all permit a capability before production use.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 08
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Emergency disable always overrides feature enablement and preserves completed work/history.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 09
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Every user-facing activated capability has approved English and Spanish content; regulated content is never automatically machine-translated for production.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 10
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Member status is created only from authoritative confirmed-enrollment evidence, never from saved, submitted, initiated, or pending states.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 11
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Consent evidence pins purpose, actor, exact version, language, method, context, transaction, and time and is never overwritten.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 12
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Consent withdrawal is prospective and cannot erase completed transaction evidence or legally retained records.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 13
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Household representation always distinguishes signer/actor from represented adult and obeys the destination's signature and authorization rules.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 14
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Tasks and exceptions use fixed types/states; no tenant-defined workflow or universal override exists.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 15
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Transaction history, signed outputs, submitted applications, external handoffs, callbacks, and audit evidence are append-only or versioned, never silently rewritten.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 16
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Exactly one active provider route exists per tenant and service; absence of a valid route disables the dependent capability.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 17
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Agency-owned and JET pay-to-use provider activity retain the route and commercial model used at transaction time.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 18
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Production never substitutes a simulated provider success or silently switches providers.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 19
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Retries occur only when the action is safe and use the immutable original request; corrections create linked new versions.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 20
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Callbacks are authenticated, deduplicated, correlated, and cannot create business outcomes without a matching authorized transaction.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 21
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Manual CSV imports are all-or-nothing; any blocking row error prevents commit.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 22
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Exports are scoped to authorized records and fields, apply masking/privacy controls, expire, and are audited.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 23
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Passwords, OTPs, tokens, MFA secrets, private keys, and provider credentials never appear in application data, logs, URLs, analytics, exports, documentation, or audit payloads.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 24
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Audit records are append-only and cannot be edited or deleted through application interfaces.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 25
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Legal holds override deletion and de-identification eligibility while preserving ordinary authorized access where permitted.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 26
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Deployment, commercial activation, provider readiness, feature enablement, launch gates, and tenant rollout are separate controlled decisions.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 27
Business_Rule_Register.statement: The protected M01 baseline and identifiers remain unchanged; every behavioral impact is represented by append-only PMI/PDM and linked M1D records.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 28
Business_Rule_Register.statement: All material configuration, policy, schema, API, event, and content changes are versioned and traceable to a release.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 29
Business_Rule_Register.statement: No Phase 1 or North Star capability is included merely because it exists upstream; Lucie implements only the approved lean MVP behavior and protected seams.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Invariant rule 30
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Every requirement, rule, contract, screen, test, task, and delta has a stable ID and passes referential-integrity validation before packet release.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Tenant provisioning authority
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Only an authorized JET Platform Administrator may create, suspend, end, or change ownership of a tenant.

Business_Rule_Register.title: One tenant owner
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A tenant has exactly one owning organization at any effective time.

Business_Rule_Register.title: One production marketplace
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A Lucie tenant has at most one active production marketplace in the MVP.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Agency relationship shape
Business_Rule_Register.statement: An agency organization has at most one active parent relationship at a time.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Workforce invitation
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A workforce account cannot become active without a valid invitation, verified email, MFA enrollment, and accepted terms/privacy.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Consumer account threshold
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Authentication is required before save/resume, protected documents, application, signature, or formal handoff.

Business_Rule_Register.title: MFA requirement
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Every active workforce identity has at least one approved active MFA enrollment.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Role assignment scope
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Agency administrators may grant only approved agency roles inside their permitted organization hierarchy.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Seat enforcement
Business_Rule_Register.statement: An invitation cannot be accepted when it would exceed the tenant's workforce seat allocation.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Member activation
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Member Workspace activates only after authoritative enrollment confirmation is linked to the consumer.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Language default
Business_Rule_Register.statement: English is used when no user or journey language preference exists.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Language persistence
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Authenticated language preference is profile-scoped and anonymous preference is journey-scoped until registration.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Optional consent
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Optional marketing and channel choices are unselected by default and cannot block required transactions.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Consent reuse
Business_Rule_Register.statement: An unchanged active consent is not recollected unless expired, revoked, or materially revised.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Representation scope
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Authorized-representative permissions use only the fixed MVP scope codes and may be revoked prospectively.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Privacy request status
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A privacy request may close only as COMPLETED or DENIED; DENIED requires an approved reason when disclosure is permitted.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Task assignment scope
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Agency users may assign or reassign work only within the permitted tenant and organization hierarchy.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Urgent priority
Business_Rule_Register.statement: URGENT priority is used only for time-sensitive enrollment, compliance, security, or material customer impact.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Duplicate task prevention
Business_Rule_Register.statement: The same unresolved task or exception key updates the existing record rather than creating a duplicate.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Override restriction
Business_Rule_Register.statement: No generic override exists; each permitted override is explicitly defined by the owning module and fully audited.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Connector activation
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A connector cannot enter ACTIVE until its definition, environment, credentials, tests, and applicable gates are READY/PASSED.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Provider route uniqueness
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A tenant/service pair has at most one ACTIVE production provider route.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Provider route selection
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Provider routing is resolved server-side from tenant, service, environment, effective date, and route status.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Pay-to-use attribution
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Every JET pay-to-use provider action creates a usage record even when the provider outcome fails.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Import atomicity
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A manual structured import commits only after the entire file passes blocking validation.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Export purpose
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Every sensitive or audit export records purpose, requester, scope, expiry, and the export event itself.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Job cancellation
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A background job can be canceled only before an irreversible external action is confirmed.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Callback authority
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A callback cannot create or finalize an outcome unless it is authenticated and matched to an authorized existing transaction.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Launch decision
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Only the named JET Release Owner records final production go/no-go.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Pilot rollout
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Production rollout begins with JET validation and one approved pilot before cohort expansion.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Defect gate
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Any unresolved CRITICAL defect blocks production activation; HIGH blocks the affected capability unless safely disabled.

Business_Rule_Register.title: Offboarding continuity
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Tenant offboarding cannot silently cancel coverage, erase external submissions, or remove legally retained evidence.

Business_Rule_Register.title: M01 delta gate
Business_Rule_Register.statement: A non-No-Impact M01 finding cannot be closed without a corresponding proposed delta or explicit governed deferment.

Business_Rule_Register.title: PlanAI name
Business_Rule_Register.statement: All new user-facing and canonical Lucie artifacts use PlanAI; legacy Plan-O/Plan-AI strings appear only in compatibility and traceability contexts.

Business_Rule_Register.title: No production impersonation
Business_Rule_Register.statement: Production sessions always identify the actual authenticated actor and never impersonate another user.
