Requirement_Register.statement: Provider calls shall use bounded timeout, exponential backoff with jitter, circuit breaking, concurrency limits, and dead-letter or exception handling aligned to action safety.

Requirement_Register.title: Notification delivery safety
Requirement_Register.statement: Outbound communication requests shall be deduplicated, consent-checked, language/version-locked, provider-routed, status-tracked, and suppressed for invalid or opted-out optional channels.

Requirement_Register.title: AI service boundary
Requirement_Register.statement: PlanAI calls shall pass through an approved service boundary with tenant/context authorization, prompt/template version, allowed data classification, timeout, safe failure, audit metadata, and no direct model access from the browser.

Requirement_Register.title: AI transparency and user control
Requirement_Register.statement: User-facing PlanAI experiences shall clearly identify AI assistance, state limitations, preserve access to non-AI paths, and require human confirmation for consequential actions.

Requirement_Register.title: Test data management
Requirement_Register.statement: Local, QA, and UAT shall use synthetic or approved masked test data with deterministic fixtures, reset procedures, no production credential use, and explicit simulation markers.

Requirement_Register.title: Automated quality coverage
Requirement_Register.statement: Each requirement and reusable rule shall map to automated unit, contract, integration, end-to-end, security, accessibility, or operational tests as applicable, with no orphan requirement IDs.

Requirement_Register.title: Contract test environments
Requirement_Register.statement: Provider and upstream module integrations shall have deterministic mocks for local/QA plus sandbox/certification tests in UAT, with mandatory integration milestones before production.

Requirement_Register.title: Operational readiness reviews
Requirement_Register.statement: Each production capability shall have named ownership, dashboards, alerts, runbooks, support routing, dependency map, failure modes, recovery steps, and on-call escalation before activation.

Requirement_Register.title: Change and release observability
Requirement_Register.statement: Every deployment, configuration change, feature activation, provider-route switch, and emergency disable shall create a correlated change event visible in operational timelines.

Requirement_Register.title: Data quality controls
Requirement_Register.statement: Reference, identity, entitlement, consent, provider, and job data shall have completeness, uniqueness, referential-integrity, state-transition, freshness, and reconciliation checks with owner and remediation path.

Requirement_Register.title: Documentation as a release artifact
Requirement_Register.statement: APIs, schemas, events, permissions, screens, runbooks, migrations, and M01 deltas shall be generated or validated against the canonical registry and versioned with each release.

Risk_Register.title: Contract divergence
Risk_Register.description: M05/M04 detailed schemas diverge from FND-CTX freeze, causing duplicate or incompatible context models.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Freeze contracts before detailed build; consumer contract tests; stop work on D4 divergence.

Risk_Register.title: M01 regression
Risk_Register.description: M00 context, language, provider or status behavior breaks protected M01 shopping/handoff.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Append-only delta companion, adapters, cumulative M01 regression and activation gate.

Risk_Register.title: Cross-tenant exposure
Risk_Register.description: Incorrect context propagation or caching reveals another tenant's data.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Central authorization, tenant-aware stores/caches/search, negative tests and security monitoring.

Risk_Register.title: Provider route ambiguity
Risk_Register.description: Tenant sends through the wrong agency-owned/JET pay-to-use account.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Exactly one active route, server-side resolution, effective dating, test and audit before activation.

Risk_Register.title: Incomplete Spanish parity
Risk_Register.description: A user enters an English-only or untranslated regulated step.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Translation readiness gate, fail-closed missing regulated content, bilingual UAT.

Risk_Register.title: False member status
Risk_Register.description: Submitted or pending handoff is displayed as confirmed enrollment.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Authoritative confirmation invariant, source/freshness display and reconciliation tests.

Risk_Register.title: Representation misuse
Risk_Register.description: Primary subscriber signs for an adult without valid destination-permitted authority.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Destination-aware rules, explicit evidence, secure adult approval where required, audit and direct-action fallback.

Risk_Register.title: Identity duplication
Risk_Register.description: Same person receives duplicate accounts across marketplaces.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Global identity, verified-contact lookup with no auto-merge, controlled duplicate review.

Risk_Register.title: Sellability bypass
Risk_Register.description: Administrative or staff role performs regulated selling without allowed M08 decision.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Server-side sellability decision, fail closed and downstream regression.

Risk_Register.title: Secret exposure
Risk_Register.description: Provider credentials appear in logs, screens, exports or configuration tables.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Secrets manager references, nonredisplay, scans, redaction and privilege controls.

Risk_Register.title: Callback replay
Risk_Register.description: Duplicate or malicious callback creates duplicate or false outcome.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Signature verification, replay window, deduplication, immutable job correlation.

Risk_Register.title: Retry duplicate effect
Risk_Register.description: Replay creates duplicate message, signature request or submission.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Idempotency, immutable request, provider reference reconciliation and safe retry rules.

Risk_Register.title: Manual override abuse
Risk_Register.description: Operations marks failed external or regulated outcome successful.
Risk_Register.mitigation: No universal override, typed resolution, evidence and audit.

Risk_Register.title: Operational overload
Risk_Register.description: Shared queues or exports are exhausted by one tenant or failed provider.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Backpressure, quotas, circuit breakers, queue age alerts and scale tests.

Risk_Register.title: Legal classification delay
Risk_Register.description: Tenant activation is attempted before privacy/BAA determination.
Risk_Register.mitigation: PENDING_LEGAL_REVIEW hard gate and JET-only classification.

Risk_Register.title: Incomplete operational handover
Risk_Register.description: Operations cannot resolve connector, identity, tenant or M01 failures without engineering.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Executable runbooks, rehearsal, training gate and named owners.

Risk_Register.title: Scope creep
Risk_Register.description: Phase 1/North Star configurability is added to M00, increasing build difficulty and schedule risk.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Lean-MVP scope rule, exclusions, change control and packet self-audit.

Risk_Register.title: Documentation drift
Risk_Register.description: Code, OpenAPI, workbook, schemas and narrative diverge.
Risk_Register.mitigation: Canonical machine registry, generated artifacts and final referential-integrity checks.

Test_Register.title: Canonical ownership acceptance and guardrail
Test_Register.preconditions: Representative authorized and unauthorized actors, tenant/marketplace contexts, English and Spanish where applicable, and required upstream fixtures.
Test_Register.steps: Exercise the approved M00-DISC-CTX-001 happy path; repeat with missing, wrong, stale, suspended, disabled, duplicate, and unauthorized inputs applicable to the decision.
Test_Register.expected: The approved outcome is produced for valid input; every prohibited path fails safely; state, audit, localization, and traceability evidence match REQ-M00-001.
Test_Register.detailed_steps: Create isolated synthetic tenant, organization, marketplace, identities and role assignments required by the mapped context. | Execute the positive path for REQ-M00-001: M00 owns identity and session context, authorization decisions, shared configuration, feature controls, consent decisions, audit and event envelopes, integration context, task foundation, secrets references, environment controls, and release controls. M05 owns Tenant, Organization, and OrganizationRelationship. M04 owns MarketplaceContext, branding, product visibility, attribution, and marketplace routing. M00 may expose read models and shared administration components but shall not create competing canonical stores. | Repeat using applicable invalid, missing, expired, stale-version, suspended, wrong-tenant, wrong-marketplace, duplicate and dependency-unavailable conditions. | Verify persisted state, audit records, emitted events, user-visible English and Spanish behavior, accessibility states and downstream compatibility. | Capture machine-readable result, correlation identifiers and evidence locations against the stable requirement and acceptance IDs.
Test_Register.expected_results: Valid behavior satisfies REQ-M00-001 with no unsupported configuration or scope expansion. | Unauthorized or invalid paths fail closed with stable problem details and no sensitive-data leakage. | Retries, callbacks and concurrency do not produce duplicate or silently overwritten outcomes. | Evidence is attributable, tenant-scoped, immutable where required and traceable to the protected M01 baseline or proposed delta where applicable.
Test_Register.gherkin:
Feature: Canonical ownership acceptance and guardrail
  Scenario: Approved positive and guardrail behavior
    Given the approved M00 test context and synthetic fixtures exist
    When canonical ownership is exercised across the positive and applicable negative paths
    Then the observable result, evidence and downstream contracts conform to REQ-M00-001
Test_Register.evidence_required: automated test result | traceability record | reviewed implementation evidence

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Tenant reference code
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Must be uppercase letters, digits, or underscore, 3-40 characters, unique and immutable after activation.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Tenant owner
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Must reference one active Organization owned by M05 and cannot be null.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Marketplace route
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Hostname or route key must be unique, normalized, HTTPS-capable, and resolve to exactly one active marketplace.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Protected context
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: tenant_id, organization_id, marketplace_id, role_assignment_id, policy_version, and correlation_id are required for protected workforce actions.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: UUID fields
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Canonical IDs must parse as UUIDv4 strings and must not encode business meaning.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Effective range
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: effective_to, when present, must be later than effective_from; overlapping active versions are rejected where uniqueness applies.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Email contact
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Email values are normalized case-insensitively for lookup, validated for syntax, encrypted at rest, and not used to auto-merge identities.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Telephone contact
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Telephone values are stored in normalized international format, verified before OTP use, and masked in ordinary views.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Invitation expiry
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Invitation expires after the configured fixed window and cannot be accepted after expiry or revocation.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: MFA activation
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: A workforce account cannot enter ACTIVE unless an approved MFA enrollment is ACTIVE.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Role template code
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Must be one of the six fixed role codes; custom codes are rejected.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Permission code
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Must follow lowercase resource.action naming and exist in the fixed catalogue.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Sellability result
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Must be ALLOWED, BLOCKED, REVIEW_REQUIRED, or NOT_APPLICABLE and include evaluated_at and source version.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Session expiry
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Workforce absolute expiry cannot exceed 8 hours; inactivity timeout cannot exceed 30 minutes; step-up timestamp expires after 15 minutes.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Recovery token
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Must be single-use, cryptographically random, short-lived, and stored only as a protected verifier/hash.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Commercial status
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Must be PENDING, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, or ENDED and transitions must follow the approved lifecycle.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Entitlement code
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Must be one of IFP_ON_EXCHANGE, IFP_OFF_EXCHANGE, DENTAL, VISION, or ICHRA_EMPLOYER_QUOTING.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Channel code
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Must be CONSUMER_DIRECT, AGENT, or EMPLOYER and must be compatible with the product-line matrix.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Seat allocation
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Must be a nonnegative integer; accepting an invitation cannot cause active_count to exceed allocated_count.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Feature target
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Must be environment, all Lucie tenants, selected tenant, or named cohort; user or percentage targets are rejected.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Locale
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Must be en-US or es-US for Lucie MVP; missing locale resolves to en-US.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Geography code
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Country must be US and subdivision must match the controlled state/DC/territory reference version.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Consent definition
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Purpose, requiredness, language, content version, effective date, and status are required before activation.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Consent evidence
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Must reference an active definition matching presented language/version and include actor, context, method, and timestamp.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Verbal consent
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Requires approved script version, communication method, consumer response, consumer identity, agent identity, and time.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Representation scope
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Scope codes must be selected from COMPLETE_APPLICATION, SIGN_WHERE_PERMITTED, RECEIVE_COMMUNICATIONS, and RESPOND_TO_REQUESTS.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Member confirmation
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Member activation requires an authoritative source type and nonempty external confirmation or operational evidence reference.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Privacy request type
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Must be ACCESS, CORRECTION, PORTABILITY, ACCOUNT_CLOSURE, DELETION, or USAGE_SHARING_EXPLANATION.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Legal hold target
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Target type and target reference must resolve to an existing record set and reason/owner/start time are required.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Task status
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Must be OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, WAITING_ON_CONSUMER, WAITING_ON_EXTERNAL_PARTY, BLOCKED, or COMPLETED.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Task priority
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Must be NORMAL, HIGH, or URGENT; URGENT requires an approved reason category.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Task assignee
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Must resolve to an authorized user, fixed operational team, consumer, employer contact, JET operations, responsible agency, or originating system.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Exception severity
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Must map to approved severity and include responsible module, user-safe explanation, and related record.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Override evidence
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Any module-specific override requires permission, fixed reason code, written explanation, before/after value, actor, time, and evidence.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Connector definition
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Connector code, provider, supported environments, schema version, authentication type, and owner are required.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Connector lifecycle
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Only READY may transition to ACTIVE and applicable launch/provider gates must be PASSED or NOT_APPLICABLE.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Environment
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Must be LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT, QA, UAT, or PRODUCTION; production credentials/data are rejected in nonproduction.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Provider commercial model
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Must be AGENCY_OWNED, JET_PAY_TO_USE, or NOT_ENABLED; only one ACTIVE route exists per tenant/service/environment.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Retry request
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Manual retry must reference the immutable original request version and cannot include edited business payload.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Webhook receipt
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Provider event ID, connector, received time, signature result, payload hash, and processing status are required.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Import format
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Upload must be CSV using the approved template version; unknown columns, formulas, macros, and arbitrary worksheets are rejected.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Import commit
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Commit is permitted only when blocking_error_count equals zero and the file hash matches the validated file.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Export request
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Purpose, scope, approved field set, requester, tenant context, and expiry are required before generation.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Job cancellation
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Cancellation is rejected when irreversible_external_effect_at is present or status is terminal.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Usage record
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Tenant, provider service, transaction type, quantity, outcome, business reference, route, and occurred_at are required.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Launch gate evidence
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Gate decision must include evidence or a NOT_APPLICABLE rationale and approved actor.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: UAT result
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Scenario, participant role, environment, language when user-facing, result, evidence, and accepted limitation are required.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Defect severity
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Must be CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW; critical cannot be marked release-accepted.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: Release artifact digest
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Deployed release must reference an immutable artifact digest and matching source/build provenance.

Validation_Rule_Register.title: M01 impact disposition
Validation_Rule_Register.statement: Must be one of No change, Clarification, Compatible addition, UI/terminology revision, Behavioral revision, Contract/data migration, Regression-only, or Deferred dependency.
